turns.user_utterance: I'm at an ATM and the machine keeps rejecting my card when I enter my PIN.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when you enter your PIN at the ATM, do you see a specific error message (for example “PIN failed” / “card blocked” / “try again later”), and how many times have you tried?

turns.user_utterance: The screen just shows “PIN failed,” and I’ve tried entering it three times already.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since it says “PIN failed” after three attempts, this is most likely a PIN verification issue and your PIN may now be blocked for ATM use. Have you recently tried to withdraw more than three times (at any ATM), or did you recently change your PIN? If you haven’t, I can help you with unblocking/changing your PIN—also, please don’t keep trying at the ATM.

turns.user_utterance: I haven’t changed my PIN, and this was just my third attempt today.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—since you’re seeing “PIN failed” and it’s already your third attempt today (without changing your PIN), your PIN is very likely blocked for ATM use. Please stop trying at the ATM. Can you confirm whether you’ve tried withdrawing at any other ATM today, and do you want to change or unblock your PIN?
